definition: סֶ֫מֶל noun masculine Ezek 8:5 perhaps originally proper name, of divinity, then generally image, statue (Phoenician סמל id. , feminine סמלת , Lzb 151, 329 , also פנסמלת Id 329 ; Bau Rel. i. 88 understands ׳ ס to be designation of foreign god); — absolute ׳ הַסּ 2Chr 33:7 ; 2Chr 33:15 , סָ֑מֶל Deut 4:16 construct סֵ֫מֶל Ezek 8:3 ; Ezek 8:5 — image, figure of anything, ׳ פֶּסֶל תְּמוּנַת כָּלסֿ Deut 4:16 idol-image ׳ פֶּסֶל הַסּ 2Chr 33:7 and ( פֶּסֶל omitted) v 2Chr 33:15 סֵמֶל הַקִּנְאָה Ezek 8:3 the statue of jealousy , i.e. that rouses ׳ י 's jealousy, = v Ezek 8:5 .
